title: New Customer's representative field looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep C.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "customer-16-n2-new.png" (board 2.16), "customer-17-n2-new-menu.png" (board 2.17) and "customer-18-n2-new-ps.png" (board 2.18) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the Customers page in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open New Customer and compare with the picture of board 2.16.
  2. Type a customer name.
  3. Click the + and compare with the picture of board 2.17.
  4. Add "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  5. Pick sales rep C in it and compare with the picture of board 2.18.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • New Customer has the same optional "Sales Representative" field and + as Edit Customer, in the same spot.

Step 2:

  • The name shows in the window.

Step 3:

  • The menu has the same two options as Edit Customer.

Step 4:

  • The "Sales Representative - Part Sales" field shows.

Step 5:

  • "Sales Representative" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" show.
  • "Sales Representative - Part Sales" reads sales rep C, with its remove x, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned". Under S4-R27 a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated is never copied: the added field then starts "Unassigned", and the field they hold keeps them (S4-N2).”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.16 New Customer: the same field; 2.17 New Customer: the + menu; 2.18 New Customer with a Part Sales rep (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-16-n2-new.png, customer-17-n2-new-menu.png, customer-18-n2-new-ps.png.
